name: Deep Moss
meaning: The color of ancient forests and untouched wilderness. Deep Moss brings a grounding, restorative energy to any space, connecting us back to the earth.

name: Pacific Depths
meaning: A profound, boundless blue representing the mystery of the open ocean. It evokes silence, depth, and infinite possibility.

name: Morning Mist
meaning: The soft, diffused light of early morning. A neutral tone that clears the mind and offers a blank canvas for new beginnings.

name: Terracotta Clay
meaning: Warm, baked earth functionality. Terracotta represents craftsmanship, home, and the raw beauty of natural materials.

name: Olive
meaning: Muted yellow-green tones evoking peace, restraint, and the quiet of olive groves. A versatile neutral-green that grounds warm and cool palettes alike.

name: Sea Green
meaning: Balanced blue-green hues suggesting shallow coastal waters and tumbled sea glass. Calm and restorative without turning cold.

name: Steel Blue
meaning: Cool, metallic blue-gray suggesting polished steel and overcast skies. Steady and professional rather than playful.

name: Cadet Blue
meaning: Pale blue-green tones evoking cadet uniforms and a calm, scholarly air. Quiet enough to sit behind body text.

name: Pine Green
meaning: Deep, resinous green recalling pine needles and shaded evergreen forest. Anchors a palette with natural authority.

name: Sienna
meaning: Warm reddish-brown earth tones evoking raw pigment and sun-baked clay. Adds organic weight to any composition.

name: Chocolate
meaning: Rich warm brown tones evoking cocoa, soil, and quiet comfort. A dependable anchor for earthy schemes.

name: Tan
meaning: Light brown-beige neutral tones suggesting sand, leather, and open plains. A safe, breathable background hue.

name: Sandy Brown
meaning: Warm sandy orange-browns evoking beach dunes and sunlit shoreline. Lively yet still within the earth family.

name: Burly Wood
meaning: Pale woody tan tones suggesting unfinished timber and gentle domestic warmth. Soft enough for large surfaces.

name: Khaki
meaning: Light yellow-brown neutral tones evoking field cloth and dry summer grass. A muted bridge between green and brown.

name: Dark Khaki
meaning: Muted olive-tan shades suggesting durable twill and autumn undergrowth. Deeper than khaki but equally restrained.

name: Salmon
meaning: Soft pink-orange tones evoking river salmon, coral, and gentle warmth. A welcoming accent that pairs with both cool and warm palettes.

name: Orchid
meaning: Light purple-pink tones evoking orchid blooms and quiet elegance. A gentle floral accent for refined compositions.
